name: Liquid Filling Line
description: Integrated equipment for filling liquid products into bottles or containers, often combined with rinsing, capping, labeling and conveying.

name: Blow-Fill-Cap Combi
description: Integrated PET bottle blowing, filling and capping equipment for high-throughput beverage lines.

name: Labeling Machine
description: Automatic systems for applying labels to bottles, cartons or other packages.

name: Vertical Form-Fill-Seal Machine
description: Vertical packaging equipment that forms a bag from rollstock, fills product and seals the package.

name: Horizontal Flow Wrapper
description: Horizontal flow-pack equipment commonly used for food, bakery, daily goods and industrial products.

name: Premade Pouch Packing Machine
description: Automatic packaging equipment for pre-made pouches and doypacks.

name: Cartoning Machine
description: Automatic equipment for erecting, loading and closing cartons.

name: Case Erector
description: Equipment that forms corrugated cases for downstream packing.

name: Case Sealer
description: Equipment that automatically closes and seals corrugated cases.

name: Shrink Wrapping Machine
description: Equipment that wraps products or bundles in shrink film and applies heat to shrink the film.

name: Strapping Machine
description: Equipment for applying plastic or other straps around cartons, bundles or pallets.

name: Palletizer
description: Automatic or robotic systems that arrange packaged products onto pallets.

name: Vacuum Packaging Machine
description: Equipment that removes air from a package before sealing, commonly used in food processing.

name: Filling & Capping Machine
description: Integrated equipment for dosing liquid or semi-liquid products and applying caps or closures.

name: Bottling Line
description: Integrated packaging line for bottles, typically covering conveying, filling, capping and downstream packaging.
